# Reich & Binstock LLP

> Houston-based personal injury law firm specializing in sexual abuse claims, social media addiction lawsuits, and product liability cases with nationwide representation.

Reich & Binstock LLP is a personal injury law firm headquartered in Houston, Texas, focusing on high-impact civil litigation cases including sexual abuse claims against institutions, clergy, and professionals, as well as emerging product liability cases involving social media and video game addiction harm to youth. The firm handles cases nationwide and represents survivors under frameworks like the Child Victims Act.
